SR-001.justification: Bases V1-V3 with Exec::Never and Exec::Program and fork; a forked bash executes /bin/echo, /usr/bin/env and /bin/sh and each is refused (EPERM or EACCES), while Exec::Granted runs them, on macOS, T1, T2 and T1 with reporting. The program starts under Base::None on Linux and Base::V1 on macOS (macOS Base::None is refused by design, spec US2). The interpreter and self routes are SR-007's canary. Passed 2026-11-12 (macOS 26.6.2, Linux 7.0.14).

SR-002.justification: Under Exec::Program, while one run of a cage executes zsh (macOS) or sh (Linux), a bash run of the same cage cannot execute it; on Linux a program renamed over by another file cannot execute its path again (inode-bound rule). Passed on macOS, T1 and T2.

SR-004.justification: The oracle adds exec never/program with bases V1 and V3 and asks every tree program for exec; the running caged child executes each one (X probe) and explain agrees with the kernel on macOS (1,278 questions per policy), T1 and T2 (1,277).

SR-005.justification: The table rows exec-never and exec-program are checked against the lowering on every target and ABI; accepted exec-program and exec-never approximations appear in the run receipt's approximations.

SR-006.justification: Every truncation is an error, header counts and path length are bounded, the fuzz target ran 40,426,256 inputs in 301 s without a panic, and an ELF with a relative interpreter fails with SpawnError::Interpreter before forking.

SR-007.justification: Under Exec::Never on T1 and T2 the started program's exec of itself, of its ELF interpreter loading /bin/echo, and its own exec replacement all fail with EPERM; with reporting the refused execve is one violation with DeniedBy::Exec and the program had started.

SR-008.justification: Cage::exec under Exec::Never on Linux fails before anything is applied with the gap; accepted, it runs and other programs are refused. With an outer listener the cage is a gap naming allow(Construct::ExecNever); accepted it runs and the receipt lists it. Exec::Program's gap names allow=["exec-program"].

SR-009.justification: 8 threads spawn 12 programs each under Exec::Never, without and with reporting, and every spawn returns and runs; the started program holds no descriptor beyond stdio.
